Corrective explicit structural revision of revision 4. It is rejected for execution: it dropped mandatory writing, cleanup and ALL three accepted public outputs. Return the COMPLETE TaskPlan, not a partial adaptation fragment. Preserve accepted requirements and contracts exactly.

First restore these required operations from revision 2: save_products_xlsx using operation cap_37c513d225bb1b870053c5d3 after all visits, filePath "workflows/schema-portability-20261002/compactv1320261012a-amazon-1/products.xlsx", rows, append:false; root.always contains close_browser using cap_bdb7ba9ab04b18783883fa86. root.outputs MUST be products_xlsx_path from the successful writer's declared path, completion_status with the accepted success/failed enum using actual typed checks, and observed_errors:array<string|null>. Do not replace these with rows/productRows. Preserve open_amazon_fr, fill_search_query, observe_search_results and every requested individual product visit. Do not restore the removed unrequested action.

Fix exactly the diagnosed each declarations: project_home_rows.each={input:"pages",output:"controlRows"}; extract_product_links.each={input:"pages",output:"productCandidateRows"}; project_product_fact_blocks.each={input:"pages",output:"factBlockRows"}. Each output name must equal its declared assembled result field, already array<array<record>>. Keep field syntax now corrected. Check acquisition success, non-null snapshot and actual false captureTruncated/manifestTruncated metadata before adaptation; a prose claim of completeness does not validate it.

The current proposal still calls learned compact records originals. They are NOT the original producer records. Retain originals by typed per-page foreach projection of field(item,"records") and one-level flatten. Every source page remains processed. Give each decision narrow candidates with unchanged observed identity plus only decision facts; keep href/actions in originals when not needed for the decision. Selection IDs must be validated against the offered candidate list, then resolved against ORIGINAL records before navigation. Apply the same two lookups to selected name/description/price IDs. Preserve order/repetitions and exact original text. Non-null selected IDs need real matching identity types; use typed checks for optional original identities, never invented keys. Selection of products is at most ten with real maxItems bounds, not just a boolean has_products.

Remove extract_product_fields mode:interpret: it only copies already typed lookup results and can rewrite text. Resolve each selected fact by existing bounded typed scopes and direct field(item,"text"). For missing facts, use an explicit nullable branch returning a singleton [null]; for present facts, strict offered lookup precedes original lookup and a singleton typed projection returns one complete observed block. A nullable fact ID (string|null) can express this directly; maintain matching array<string|null> branch exports. Build product rows from these typed values in bounded singleton scopes if needed. Never index an array with field, json-decode binding descriptions, or use inference for these copies. No fabricated errors; errors require producer evidence, interface control text is not an error.

The current assemble_excel_rows is also wrong: flatten([headerRow]) removes the row and omits products. Use the exact EXISTING binding below in the writer, where visit_products.product_row must be array<array<string|null>> (adjust only that scope export to provide the complete typed rows):
{"kind":"flatten","items":[{"kind":"array","items":[{"kind":"array","items":[{"kind":"array","items":[{"kind":"string","text":"name"},{"kind":"string","text":"description"},{"kind":"string","text":"price"},{"kind":"string","text":"error"}]}]},{"kind":"output","source":"visit_products","port":"product_row"}]}]}
This is flatten([[headerRow],productRows]), preserving header, every product row and null cell positions. Typed copies, row assembly and final status/path exports require no inference. Preserve necessary bounded validation and local requires before effects. No filters, deduplication, new user inputs, operators or permissions. Return all navigation, adaptation, product visits, writer, cleanup and accepted root outputs together.
